findings.excerpt: Revenue of $1.56 billion, up 20% reported and 16% organic year-over-year

findings.claim: Q4 organic 成長指引 11–12%，低於 Q3 organic 16%（報導稱股價盤後跌逾 15%）。
findings.source: Twilio press release: Twilio announces third quarter 2026 results
findings.excerpt: an organic revenue growth range of 11% to 12% year-over-year

findings.claim: CPaaS 市場規模與預測差異極大（IMARC 2025 年 $14.9B、2026–2034 年成長率 20.23%；其他機構 CAGR 28%+），僅供方向參考。
findings.source: WebSearch result summary (IMARC / Fortune Business Insights / Global Growth Insights)

findings.source: CX Today: Gartner Magic Quadrant CPaaS 2026
